definition: An area of computer vision is active vision, sometimes also called active computer vision.
details: An active vision system is one that can manipulate the viewpoint of the camera(s) in order to investigate the environment and get better information from it.
story: Picture walking through a crowd and instantly picking out a familiar face without reading a single name tag. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. Sight, for a machine, is a long climb from raw light to a name. That pixel-to-meaning climb is Active vision.
